text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened during dance lessons for the 
upcoming concert—

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: Yes! Turn right there! And strike a pose!

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
That was wonderful, Bourbon-san! Your 
performance truly conveyed your feelings!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Is there something on your mind?
Is there something on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I have no 'thoughts' on the matter.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, I determine there are no 
"feelings" involved either.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"The instructions given to me. I sang and 
danced simply to fulfill the performance. 
Yet the teacher said, 'Your feelings truly 
come across.'"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: What on earth did I convey?
choice_data_list:
Like conveying the feelings put into the 
lyrics, or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...That is impossible for me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Pouring emotion into the lyrics. In other 
words, to do so, one must be able to 
resonate with the lyrics.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, there are many lyrics I do not 
comprehend. In this state, conveying the 
message is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not able to put on a live performance 
like the one Falcon-san showed us before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Deliver my feelings to someone with all 
my might"... That mission remains 
unfulfilled.
choice_data_list:
You really have a strong desire to "reach 
out," don't you?

You have that desire to “reach them,” 
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A desire to 'reach them', is that it?
choice_data_list: I think those feelings reached them.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Preparations complete. Resuming transit to 
today's stage.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Um, Bourbon-san! Are you going on stage 
now?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Target search... Complete. Are you the 
person who previously sent me fan mail?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, that's right! You actually 
remembered!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for coming today.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Ah. Talking to you right before the 
live concert! I was just getting in your 
way, wasn't I!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I'm really looking forward to 
the stage show!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Target has begun running. Lost to a 
location where conversation is impossible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Intended message: "Your letter gave me 
energy"... Transmission failed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...As expected, expressing emotions is not 
my forte.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the 3rd Live began.
